name: ssz-presets
prompt: Cascaded shadow maps put 4 tiles per view in one shadow map; each tile is 2048 texels across, so one view's map is 4096 x 4096 (64 MB). A new graphics setting, shadowResolution (1024 or 2048), sets the tile size; the low-end, handheld and phone presets use 1024. In builtinTargets(), add `"shadowResolution": 1024` to the `"graphics"` object of five presets: desktop-low, steam-deck, handheld-pc, android and ios. Put it right after the `"msaa"` entry in each, as `"msaa": 1, "shadowResolution": 1024,` (keep each preset's own msaa value). In each of those five description strings, after the part about MSAA or shadows, add `, 1024 shadow tiles` where it reads naturally (keep it one string). Change nothing else; the desktop preset stays "{}".
